soilHealthCard.title: Soil Health Card
soilHealthCard.subtitle: Digital Soil Mapping & Soil Health Portal
soilHealthCard.labSubtitle: SOIL, WATER, FERTILIZER AND PEST TESTING LABORATORY
soilHealthCard.phaseNotice: Comprehensive laboratory and estimated soil nutrient diagnostics for your agricultural field.
soilHealthCard.summarySubtitle: Quick overview of key soil fertility indicators for your field
soilHealthCard.obs1: Soil reaction (pH 8.38) indicates moderately alkaline condition typical of Vertisols (Black Cotton Soils).
soilHealthCard.obs2: Electrical conductivity is within the safe / normal range, indicating no immediate salinity hazards.
soilHealthCard.obs3: Organic carbon level is very high (> 0.80%), demonstrating excellent organic matter retention.
soilHealthCard.obs4: Available nitrogen is low (< 280 kg/ha); split application of nitrogenous fertilizers or green manuring is suggested.
soilHealthCard.obs5: Available phosphorus is in the medium range; maintain balanced phosphatic fertilization.
soilHealthCard.obs6: Potassium is in the very high category; basal potassium doses can be optimized.
soilHealthCard.labAddress: Agricultural Diagnostic & Digital Soil Testing Center, Baramati / Pune, Maharashtra
